scope: synthetic household engineering checks, not psychological validation
checks: multiple independent private-context replies use previously received speech
elapsed response intervals resolve intended turns and account both participants
same-room bystanders overhear and acquire received affect
explicit adjoining-room audibility does not establish firsthand acquaintance
closed-room person receives no conversation memory or mood update
spoken allegations never become canonical facts
agent environment context reveals only same-room presence, never private profiles or remote locations
JSON and SQLite restore locations, received turns, calendar and conversation state
mid-response checkpoint resumes identically without replaying completed events or time accounting
failed bystander appraisal rolls back turn, action, calendars and all recipients; retry commits once
unavailable invited participant cannot be forced into a conversation
response interval cannot cross the end of a waking window
calendar commitments prevent double-booked conversation participation
movement during a response cancels speech before it is delivered
death during a response prevents posthumous speech
independently chosen departure changes physical routing and ends an undersized conversation
infant conversation participation is nonverbal with no adult plan
invalid physical policy is rejected before runtime mutation
archived policies remain free of implicit rooms or invented conversations
daily availability also gates ordinary elapsed activity reservations
silent action contracts reject contradictory model speech
resolved dialogue actions feed existing developmental exposure gates; overhearing alone does not count as enacted behavior
explicit room contact cannot begin with a remotely located person
physical contact activity cannot resolve after a participant leaves its room
